mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND payment_status = 'pending'
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'failed' AND created_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (tenant_id, order_number, customer_id, appointment_id, resource_id, resource_type, subtotal, tax_rate, tax_amount, tip_amount, tip_percentage, total_amount, payment_method, payment_status, order_status, notes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderNumber}, #{customerId}, #{appointmentId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceType}, #{subtotal}, #{taxRate}, #{taxAmount}, #{tipAmount}, #{tipPercentage}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{notes}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) = DATE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) = YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) AND MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) = MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) ORDER BY created_at DESC
